evidence.value: English is widely spoken in business and near-universal in the business community; Estonian is the official language and the first language of about two-thirds of residents. For B2B and technology audiences, English usually works well.

source.name: OECD, Financing SMEs and Entrepreneurs 2026: Estonia

evidence.value: SMEs are 99.9% of all registered companies. Micro-enterprises (fewer than 10 employees) are 95% of all enterprises. SMEs employed 83% of the workforce in 2023 and 81% of the private-sector workforce in 2024, and accounted for about 79-81% of total value added.
